answer: A shared atlas maps every identity to its stake and history, so forging many identities means posting many separate bonds. Sybil resistance can use a staked identity knoll: each agent must lock collateral on a public ledge before voting or earning. Attackers must front real capital per fake identity, and misbehavior slashes it, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
